description: This file defines the Candidate class entity for the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It models candidate data, including personal details, application mode, and relationships to other entities like vacancy, attachment, and history.

classes.name: Candidate
classes.description: Entity class representing a job candidate, including personal information, application details, and relationships to other entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the candidate.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the candidate.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Retrieves the candidate's first name.

methods.name: setFirstName
methods.description: Sets the candidate's first name.

methods.name: getMiddleName
methods.description: Retrieves the candidate's middle name, if any.

methods.name: setMiddleName
methods.description: Sets the candidate's middle name.

methods.name: getLastName
methods.description: Retrieves the candidate's last name.

methods.name: setLastName
methods.description: Sets the candidate's last name.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the candidate's email address.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the candidate's email address.

methods.name: getContactNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the candidate's contact number.

methods.name: setContactNumber
methods.description: Sets the candidate's contact number.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the candidate's status (deprecated).

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the candidate's status (deprecated).

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves any comment associated with the candidate.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a comment for the candidate.

methods.name: getModeOfApplication
methods.description: Retrieves the mode of application (manual or online).

methods.name: setModeOfApplication
methods.description: Sets the mode of application.

methods.name: getDateOfApplication
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the application was made.

methods.name: setDateOfApplication
methods.description: Sets the date of application.

methods.name: getCvFileId
methods.description: Retrieves the CV file ID (deprecated).

methods.name: setCvFileId
methods.description: Sets the CV file ID (deprecated).

methods.name: getCvTextVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the text version of CV (deprecated).

methods.name: setCvTextVersion
methods.description: Sets the text version of CV (deprecated).

methods.name: getKeywords
methods.description: Retrieves keywords associated with the candidate.

methods.name: setKeywords
methods.description: Sets keywords for the candidate.

methods.name: getAddedPerson
methods.description: Retrieves the employee who added this candidate.

methods.name: setAddedPerson
methods.description: Sets the employee who added this candidate.

methods.name: isConsentToKeepData
methods.description: Checks if the candidate consented to data retention.

methods.name: setConsentToKeepData
methods.description: Sets the candidate's consent to data retention.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Retrieves the vacancies this candidate applied for.

methods.name: getCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves attachments related to this candidate.

methods.name: getCandidateHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the history of actions related to this candidate.
